Senior Angular Developer, Ola — Dec 2022 - Present
Led front-end development for rider and passenger web features, delivering a responsive booking dashboard used by 150k monthly users. Implemented component libraries and optimized bundle sizes, reducing initial load time by 35%. Built reactive data flows for live trip tracking using RxJS and Angular Observables, improving UI update latency by 40%. Implemented design refinements and responsive layouts using CSS and Sass variables to standardize themes across apps. Introduced unit and integration tests with Jest, increasing test coverage for critical payment and booking modules to 82%. Tracked deliverables and collaborated with cross-functional teams through Jira.

Angular Developer, Bluefin Logistics — Mar 2017 - Nov 2022
Developed fleet management and shipment tracking interfaces for logistics clients, supporting real-time status updates and route visualization. Architected modular Angular applications and migrated legacy code to TypeScript, improving maintainability and reducing defect rates. Used RxJS for handling WebSocket streams and orchestrating complex async flows, which improved event processing throughput. Styled reusable UI components with Sass and CSS, and enforced component-level testing with Jest to prevent regressions. Coordinated task backlogs and sprint planning via Jira.

Skills: Angular, TypeScript, RxJS, CSS, Jest, Sass, Jira

Education: B.Des, NID Ahmedabad
